text_block_list.text: When the training camp was almost coming to an end—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: How is Alv doing?
choice_data_list: We're just about to start training.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Mmh... She originally had the toughness to withstand
high-intensity training, but—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: That late charge is just absurd.

After preparing an environment where she could focus on training,
enlisting Air Groove's help, and implementing stress-relief measures—

Her abilities had improved significantly,
enough to make even Air Groove marvel.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Even compared to the time of the Oaks, the difference was stark.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Her launch from the gate, top speed, and spurt distance...
Every single one of them has shown remarkable growth.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Enough to enter the race with absolute confidence.
However—"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"It's just that I occasionally sense a hint of hesitation in her, you see.
...I only hope it's just my imagination."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Phew!
choice_data_list: Alright, after a break, it's time for strength training.
Alright, after a break, it's strength training time!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (...I've become... stronger.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(—The power in the stride. The turnover of the legs.
The center of gravity control. None of my abilities have declined.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(...Right now, I should be able to overpower both
my Oka Sho self and my Oaks self.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (With this much strength, winning the Shuka Sho is——)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Ah ha ha ha ha haaa HOT HOT HOT!!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
—Run! You can run away even more!
Hey! Look at ya! Ahhahaha!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Whoa... That's practically a massacre.

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: "She was already unbelievable before, but there's no way in hell I'd want to run against her right now..."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (She really is—strong...!)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(The sheer power digging into the turf...!
To force all of that into forward propulsion to move like that...?!)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(—She, too, is likely on an entirely different level
compared to how she was in the Oka Sho or the Oaks...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Can she win the 'Shuka Sho'?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Really...? Do you think... I can fight with confidence now...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (...I absolutely cannot lose, you know?)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (On the next one—)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: The. End.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Don't hesitate!
Hesitation will only slow your legs down...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Right now, I am at my strongest...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (But—what if she's grown even more than I have?)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: When that happens, what will become of me...?

—Summer training camp comes to an end. Having packed their bags,
the Umamusume board the shuttle bus.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I am aware.

She had developed enough ability to compete in the Shuka Sho.
However, there seemed to be a slight shadow lingering across her expression.

The autumn GⅠ season is
already right around the corner.
And the deadline for the contract between her and me, as well—
